convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom calls to custom indicators (SSL and NRTR) which are not built-in MT5 indicators. External custom indicator files are required for signal generation and trailing stop logic.

other_exits: NRTR-based trailing stop: NRTR line acts as dynamic trailing stop level, closing position when price crosses NRTR line in opposite direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative Lots value = fixed lot size (absolute value used); positive Lots value = fraction of deposit to risk

custom_logic_notes: EA uses two custom indicators: SSL (for trend direction via crossover of high/low based moving averages) and NRTR (Nickel Reverse True Range - for dynamic trailing stop). Entry requires both SSL and NRTR to agree on direction. Opposite positions are closed before opening new direction. Time filter allows restricting trading to specific hours. NRTR trailing stop overrides fixed trailing stop when active.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of SSL and NRTR custom indicator logic in Python. SSL is a channel-based trend indicator using SMA of High and Low. NRTR (Nickel Reverse True Range) is a dynamic trailing stop indicator based on ATR-like volatility. The digit adjustment logic (multiplying SL/TP/Trail by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled. Position sizing has dual mode: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction. Time filter and new-bar guard must be replicated. Signal reversal close uses NRTR line breakout.
